verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a natural-language command interface, chat assistant, or prompt-driven way to operate Alloy. The 'agentic automation' marketing line describes automated KYC/AML checks, not user-issued natural-language commands. The llms.txt docs index is a machine-readable documentation surface for AI agents, which is adjacent and not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
